title: Safe-apply: preflight validation service + diff generation for Optimize config changes
author: Jordan Lee
description: Context: As part of the Safe apply + rollback mechanism, we need a deterministic preflight step before an optimization config version can be applied to a scope (route/model/customer/region/cluster). This PR adds a preflight validation service that runs schema + policy checks, generates a structured diff/preview payload for Console, and performs a dry-run propagation simulation to catch common runtime hazards (batching/caching/quantization) before we roll anything out. What’s included: (1) New endpoint POST /internal/optimize/config/preflight that accepts {scope, base_version_id, candidate_config, options} and returns {result, warnings, errors, diff, risk_summary}. (2) Diff generation (JSON-pointer keyed) with redaction rules for secrets and stable ordering for UI rendering. (3) Validation rules: schema validation against OptimizeConfig v3, guardrails for batching knobs (max_batch_tokens, max_concurrent_sequences, continuous batching toggles), caching constraints (prefix/KV cache enablement + invalidation mode), routing constraints (fallback policy presence when tightening limits), and quantization profile compatibility (cannot apply a profile that the runtime reports unsupported for the selected model family/hardware tier). (4) Dry-run propagation simulation: evaluates rollout plan for the target scope (clusters/regions), verifies that all targeted runtime shards report compatible capabilities, and estimates blast radius when the change touches "hot" knobs (scheduler/batching/cache/quant). (5) Observability hooks: preflight counters + latency histogram, and correlation id propagation so we can tie preflight -> apply -> runtime status in dashboards. (6) Feature flag: optimize.safe_apply_preflight_enabled (default off). Non-goals (for this PR): No automatic rollback, no metric-gated canary execution (handled in later PR), and no partial-field rollback semantics (we treat the candidate config as a whole document and validate it as such). Rollout: ship behind flag, enable in internal env first, then Hosted sandbox. Once Console wiring lands, the safe-apply wizard will call this endpoint and block apply on "errors" while allowing explicit override on select "warnings" with justification. Testing: unit tests for rule evaluation + golden diff tests, integration test that spins a fake runtime capability registry and exercises dry-run behavior across mixed GPU tiers. Related: ENG-4824; depends on the version-store scaffolding from pr-10432 and version fetch/list APIs from pr-10441.

review_conversation: 2025-01-16 Chloe Martin: Can we ensure the diff payload is stable for UI? If field order changes across marshaling we’ll get flaky compare views. Jordan Lee: Good call — added stable ordering + golden tests; diff is keyed by JSON pointer and sorted lexicographically. 2025-01-16 Jada Williams: Dry-run should return “targets” (clusters/shards) so apply can use the same expansion and we avoid split-brain between preflight and apply. Jordan Lee: Updated dry-run response to include expanded target set + capability summary; added request option strict_target_match=true which will fail preflight if expansion differs from the caller’s expected targets. 2025-01-17 Sofia Ivanova: Guardrails: please don’t hardcode max_batch_tokens values globally; we need per-model-family defaults (some models handle 8k/16k differently) and the validator should treat high values as warning not error unless it exceeds an absolute safety ceiling. Jordan Lee: Adjusted rules to: (a) enforce absolute ceiling (env-configured) as error, (b) treat model-family thresholds as warnings, and (c) annotate warning with “why” + suggested max. Added config map optimize.preflight.thresholds keyed by model_family. 2025-01-18 Mateo Alvarez: Quantization compatibility check must consult runtime capabilities by hardware tier; otherwise we’ll block Private deployments where capabilities are customer-defined. Jordan Lee: Implemented capability lookup as an interface; in Private we can inject a local capability registry. If capability is unknown, we return WARN(override_allowed=true) instead of ERROR (unless strict_quant_compat=true). 2025-01-20 Allison Grant: Metrics: please add correlation_id label but do NOT add scope_id as a label (cardinality). Also want a counter by result {PASS/WARN/FAIL}. Jordan Lee: Done — added optimize_preflight_requests_total{result} + optimize_preflight_duration_ms histogram; correlation_id is emitted as log field + trace attribute, not as a metric label. 2025-01-21 Benji Okafor: How does this interact with version store? We should accept base_version_id and fail if it doesn’t match the current live version when strict_base=true. Jordan Lee: Added base_version_id passthrough + strict_base option; handler calls version service to verify base matches live when requested. 2025-01-22 Chloe Martin (requested changes): Please add explicit redaction rules for any config fields under /secrets/* and ensure logs never print candidate_config. Jordan Lee: Added redaction + log sanitization; request body logging removed, and any error logs include request_id only. 2025-01-23 Approvals: Chloe Martin approved. Sofia Ivanova approved. Mateo Alvarez approved. Jada Williams approved. Allison Grant approved. Benji Okafor approved.
release_notes: Internal-only (flagged): adds preflight validator endpoint + diff payload for Optimize safe-apply wizard. No customer-visible changes until optimize.safe_apply_preflight_enabled is enabled.
